answer_presence_diagnostic.scope: Exploratory diagnostic motivated by validation-only error composition; not used for training, tuning, candidate selection or configuration changes.

failure_analysis_scope.note: All primary-temperature stochastic pools; coverage expanded in final artifact review to include both seeds and policy disagreements. No training, tuning or policy change.

tuning.rule: max validation accuracy - token_penalty * mean fraction budget; ties use fewer tokens, then first threshold in predefined grid

generation_manifest.note: Per-call synchronized latency; prefix replay costs, no batching.

latency_scope: Recorded synchronized generation latency summed over used prefix. Verifier latency not included; adaptive outcomes are offline replay.
